note: Hand-written for the Microsoft Graph reference Download the contents of a DriveItem (GET /me/drive/items/{item-id}/content). The reference answers that call with a 302 to a pre-authenticated URL, which the client follows through the redirect policy of apollia_core::net; what it reads at the end is the file body, and that body is what this fixture serves directly. A CSV with CRLF line endings, so a line-ending normalisation or a truncation at the carriage return would show. Not a recording.
